title: Dashboard
lead: Where the money and the time go, and which models are fast and cheap. Every call records its time, model, usage and cost; this page sums them by episode, scene, shot and component. Updated at {{time}}.

scope.label: Scope
scope.noteSeriesOne: {{episodes}} episodes; only episode {{n}} is in production, so the charts below show episode {{n}}

insight.one_off_assets: One-off assets are the bulk of it: voice design {{voice}}, reference images and on-screen text {{images}}, {{share}}% of the spend together. From episode 2 on they are reused at no cost.
insight.slowest_shot: Video generation takes the longest. Shot {{shot}} alone took {{minutes}} minutes: one local timeout, then a model switch.
insight.pricey_model: {{model}} costs {{price}} per second, {{ratio}}× {{vs}}; used once on {{shot}} and failed QA.
